question: Will Hormuz reopen by New Year, yes or no?

lines.text: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say their two thousand kilometre missile range limit has been lifted.
lines.note: IRGC spokesman, via ToI and AP

lines.text: Spokesman Hossein Mohebbi told reporters in Tehran: that restriction has been lifted for us.

scene.quote: that restriction has been lifted for us

lines.text: For years, the Guards said they kept their missiles to about two thousand kilometres.
He did not say whether Iran has missiles that can fly further.
In the strait, Iran's navy says a tanker hit a mine and caught fire.
lines.note: Iran's navy, via Reuters, Al Jazeera

lines.text: It says the ship had its transponder off. Washington says the mines have been cleared.
UKMTO says at least eleven ships were attacked in the week to sixth November. Three sank.
lines.note: UKMTO weekly report, via Al Jazeera

lines.text: It says traffic through Hormuz is about sixty five percent below pre-war levels.
Donald Trump says US forces carried out minor strikes on Qeshm Island.
Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says he spoke with twelve foreign ministers in forty eight hours.
He says he set out Iran's seven conditions to reopen the strait.
Day two hundred and fifty four tomorrow. Will Hormuz reopen by New Year, yes or no?

notes_full: IRGC range claim: Mohebbi press conference Saturday 7 Nov, first reports about 16:00 UTC (AP 16:15, UkrMedia 16:24, Asharq Al-Awsat 17:05, ToI 18:07); about 5h old at 21:00
Tanker mine fire: Iran's navy via Iranian media, first reports 7 Nov about 10:00 UTC (Iran International 10:02, L'Orient 10:31, ToI 10:42, Reuters via Al Arabiya); about 11h old
UKMTO weekly (11 ships attacked week to 6 Nov, 3 sank, transits about 65% below pre-conflict) and Araghchi 12 ministers in 48h: Al Jazeera 7 Nov
Trump minor strikes on Qeshm: said late Friday US time, reported 7 Nov from about 07:00 UTC (Al Jazeera, CNBC, MEE)
